name: starflask_get_job
description: Fetch the current status and result of a Starflask job by id. Returns {status, type, result, error, created_at, completed_at}. status progresses pending -> processing -> completed | failed. Poll this after creating any job (image/video/3d/speech/etc.) until status is 'completed' (then read the URL out of result, e.g. result.image_url / result.video_url / result.model_url) or 'failed' (read error). Wait a few seconds between polls; media jobs can take from seconds to a couple of minutes.

job_id.description: The UUID of the job returned when it was created.
